brand.name: Sharp Trademarks
brand.positioning: The clear, guided way for founders and growing businesses to protect their brand name, logo and slogan with the USPTO — without the confusion, the guesswork, or the avoidable filing mistakes.
brand.promise: You will understand what you are filing, why it matters, and what happens next.

permitted_framing: reviewed by an attorney before filing
forbidden_framing: we will defend you in court
law firm associated with the Federal Office
required_disclaimer_contexts: any post explaining USPTO rules or timelines
any post comparing legal concepts (e.g. trademark vs copyright)
disclaimer_variants: General information only — not legal advice for your specific situation.
This is general guidance, not legal advice about your mark.
legal_positioning.note: Site copy currently contains a conflicting 'law firm associated with the Federal Office' line. Until that is verified and corrected, the system will not reproduce it.
legal_positioning.mode_definition: hybrid = a trademark filing service whose work is supported and reviewed by attorneys. Sharp Trademarks may say attorneys are involved; it may never say it IS the reader's attorney, that an attorney-client relationship exists, or that it is affiliated with or endorsed by the USPTO.

modes_available.strict: No legal-status framing at all. Never mentions attorneys.
modes_available.hybrid: ACTIVE. Attorney involvement may be stated; no attorney-client relationship implied.
modes_available.law_firm: Attorney-led framing permitted. Requires bar-compliance review before enabling.

primary.who: US founders and small-business owners, 1–20 employees, 0–5 years in business
trigger_moments: found someone using a similar name
an e-commerce platform asked for brand registry proof
an investor or partner asked whether the name is protected
received a USPTO Office Action and does not understand it
beliefs_to_overturn: registering an LLC protects the name
buying the domain protects the name
a logo copyright covers the brand name
you can file later once you are bigger
the USPTO will tell you if the name is taken
fears: losing a name they already invested in

secondary.who: Agencies, e-commerce sellers, creators and franchise operators protecting multiple marks

personality.is: the sharp advisor who explains the thing your cousin's lawyer wouldn't

voice.person: second person ('you', 'your brand'); 'we' only for service statements
voice.sentence_rhythm: Lead with the claim. Then the evidence. Then the consequence.
opening_hooks: problem_reveal: 'Your LLC does not protect your name.'
cost_of_inaction: 'The cheapest time to file was before you printed the packaging.'
myth_break: 'Trademark and copyright are not the same thing.'
specificity: 'Three words decide whether your application survives.'
question_frame: 'Would your brand survive someone else filing it first?'
sequence_promise: 'Here is what actually happens after you hit submit.'

cta_style.principle: One CTA per caption. Low-friction, no pressure, no price.
approved: Save this before you name your next product.
Send this to the founder who just picked a name.
Questions about your mark? DM us — we'll point you in the right direction.
Comment SEARCH and we'll send you the clearance checklist.

voice.emoji_policy: Zero emojis in graphics. At most one in a caption, and only as a list marker. Never in the hook line.

primary.name: Sharp Teal
primary.use: accents, rules, highlights, data marks, icon strokes

rules: Every asset uses exactly one background family: navy OR paper. Never a gradient between the two.
Teal is an accent, never a background wash and never more than ~15% of the canvas.
Body text is #101f3d on light, #ffffff on navy. Never teal body text.
No colour outside this palette may appear as a flat UI element. Photographic/abstract imagery may carry incidental colour if it is desaturated toward the palette.
Minimum contrast 4.5:1 for any text under 32px, 3:1 above.
Maximum two type sizes competing for attention on any single slide.
Headlines never exceed 7 words per line or 4 lines total.
Never letterspace lowercase body text.
Never set headlines in ALL CAPS except the eyebrow label.
Never centre-align body copy longer than two lines.
The logo is ALWAYS composited by Python from these files. Gemini must never draw it.
Reversed variants on navy; standard variants on paper.
Clear space on all sides equals the height of the emblem's inner circle (~0.4x logo height).
Minimum wordmark width 180px at 1080px canvas. Below that, use the mark alone.
Never recolour, rotate, outline, add shadow to, or place the logo on a busy area of imagery.
Feed posts carry the logo once — bottom-left of the final slide or the single image footer.
Nothing important within 84px of any edge.
A single consistent left edge across all text on a slide.
Slide 1 of a carousel is the hook. The last slide is the CTA. Never both on one slide.
Carousels show a slide counter (e.g. 03/07) in the top-right at 26px.
Every slide carries the small footer lockup: sharptrademarks.com on the left, handle on the right.

imagery.role: Gemini generates atmosphere, texture and abstract structure — never text, never logos, never the layout.
approved_styles: abstract geometric fields built from concentric arcs and rising bars, echoing the emblem
soft-focus macro photography of paper, ink, embossing and document texture, heavily desaturated
clean isometric 3D of simple objects (shield, document, stamp, magnifier) in matte navy and teal
long-exposure light-trail gradients over deep navy
architectural photography with strong verticals, cool cast, shallow depth of field
minimal line-art diagrams with generous negative space
forbidden: any legible text, letterforms, numbers or signage
logos, wordmarks or brand marks of any kind
gavels, courtrooms, scales of justice, judges, wigs — legal clichés
stock-photo handshakes, thumbs-up, arrows pointing at the camera
AI artefacts: extra fingers, warped hands, melted objects
neon cyberpunk, glossy 3D chrome, lens flare, bokeh confetti
flags, government seals, eagles or anything implying official endorsement
busy centre composition — the middle-left must stay calm enough for type

composition_defaults.negative_space: at least 45% of the frame, biased to the upper-left where the headline sits
composition_defaults.lighting: single soft key from upper left, deep controlled shadows

imagery.color_direction: Restrict to deep navy #101f3d, teal #0d9488, white and neutral greys. No warm colours above 10% of the frame.

visual_systems.name: Statement
visual_systems.structure: Full-bleed generated texture at 22% opacity over navy. Eyebrow top-left, one huge headline, thin teal rule beneath, one supporting line. Logo bottom-left.

visual_systems.name: Split Frame
visual_systems.structure: Top 45% generated imagery, bottom 55% paper with eyebrow, headline and 2–3 line body. Teal rule divides them.

visual_systems.name: Numbered Steps
visual_systems.structure: Oversized teal outline numeral top-left, step title, two-line explanation, hairline rule. Consistent across a carousel.

visual_systems.name: Myth / Fact
visual_systems.structure: Upper block labelled MYTH in muted grey with strikethrough rule; lower block labelled FACT in teal. Strong horizontal divider.

visual_systems.name: Checklist
visual_systems.structure: Eyebrow, tight headline, 4–6 rows each with a teal check or cross glyph drawn by Python, hairline separators.

visual_systems.name: Two Column Compare
visual_systems.structure: Two equal columns with navy and teal headers, 3–5 matched rows, vertical hairline between.

visual_systems.name: Pull Statement
visual_systems.structure: Large teal quote bar on the left edge, one 12–20 word statement set at headline_l, attribution line beneath. Verified figures only.

visual_systems.name: Question / Answer
visual_systems.structure: Question in navy headline with a teal question glyph, answer in body below a hairline, generous space.

visual_systems.name: Closing Card
visual_systems.structure: Centred logo full-reversed, one CTA line, website, handle. Subtle generated arc texture at 15%.

visual_systems.name: Timeline
visual_systems.structure: Vertical teal spine on the left with node dots, 3–5 stages each with a bold label and one-line detail.
